tasks.title: Animate the Mini Calculator title
tasks.description: Add or enhance CSS animation to the 'Mini Calculator' h1 title element. Read src/App.tsx to locate the title element and src/App.css to see existing animation styles. Implement or improve the CSS animation using @keyframes (e.g., fade-in with slide-down, scale, or bounce effect). Apply the animation to the title element. After implementing, start the dev server in the background, take a screenshot to .eunomia/screenshots/developer/ to verify the animation appears correctly, then stop the server. No unit tests are needed for CSS animations - visual verification is sufficient.
acceptance_criteria: Title displays smooth animation on page load
Animation enhances user experience without being distracting
No layout shifts or broken styling
